title: Autonomy Register — Section G: NHI Credentials
description: Section G of the Autonomy Register entry, as specified in STD-EDS-007.

nhi_count.description: ≥ 0. If 0: system has no NHIs (must be documented and CAIO-approved — very unusual for Level 3+ systems). (Source of truth: CISO)

nhi_identifiers.description: [Mandatory if nhi_count > 0] Each identifier must match an entry in the CISO NHI register. Format per Section 2.1. (Source of truth: CISO)

ciso_nhi_register_ref.description: [Mandatory if nhi_count > 0] Format: NHI-REG-YYYY-NNN. References the CISO’s NHI lifecycle register entry for this system. (Source of truth: CISO)

credential_rotation_schedule.description: Per POL-EDS-005 Section 7.1. Maximum varies by credential type and Autonomy Level — long-lived secrets: 90/60/30 days (Levels 1–2/3/4–5); client certificates: 1 year/6 months (Levels 1–3/4–5); signing keys: 180/90 days (Levels 1–3/4–5); short-lived tokens: 24 hours at all levels. Record the schedule applicable to this NHI’s credential type. (Source of truth: CISO — per POL-EDS-005 §4)

last_credential_rotation.description: Must not exceed the credential_rotation_schedule. Triggers Level 1 incident flag if overdue. (Source of truth: CISO)

next_rotation_due.description: Computed as last_credential_rotation + credential_rotation_schedule. (Source of truth: System — computed)
